equity_bridge.item: Other financial liabilities (acquisition earn-outs, deferred installments, GUT NCI put option)
equity_bridge.note: Q2-2026 6-K balance sheet: current 97.811 + non-current 50.179; debt-like contractual cash obligations (FY25 cash paid: earn-outs 33.0, installments 11.2, NCI put 27.1)

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: base-case revenue path average (FY26-35). Equity CAGR is acquisition- and share-issuance-driven and describes a 20%+ grower that no longer exists (FY26 guide -1.1% to +0.3%).
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 18.9% vs EPS 3yr CAGR -12.9% and FY2026 guided revenue ~0%: historical CAGRs are M&A-inflated and pre-date the AI-driven demand break; not used as the forward rate.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - lease principal - lease interest. Owner-FCF CAGRs are not meaningful (FY2020 negative; FY2022 base of $4.4M makes the 3yr CAGR ~184%). Reported FCF compounded far faster than owner FCF because SBC (2.3% -> 3.2% of revenue) and lease cash grew with it.

scenario_narratives.base: Globant is a mid-cap digital-engineering firm in an AI-driven transition. Base assumes FY26 at guidance midpoint, a flat-to-low-growth FY27 while time-and-materials revenue is cannibalised by output-priced AI Pods, then mid-single-digit growth with margins recovering to ~18.5% EBITDA (pre-SBC, IFRS-16), below the FY22-24 peak because restructuring is treated as a recurring cost after two consecutive annual 'one-time' programmes.
scenario_narratives.bull: AI Pods / Glob.AI becomes a real second engine (ARR $20.6M Q4-25 -> $52.8M Q2-26 -> $110M+ exit-26 guide), carrying ~10pp higher gross margin; wallet-share gains in top accounts and the opening of the platform to non-clients re-accelerate growth to ~9% by FY28-29, and margins exceed the prior peak as headcount productivity (rev/employee +9.7% YoY) holds.
scenario_narratives.bear: The staff-augmentation model is structurally deflated by GenAI faster than AI Pods can backfill; revenue declines into FY27, customer count and $1M+ accounts keep shrinking, BOC recurs every year, LatAm FX keeps compressing margin, and the securities class action over the 2023 LatAm-pivot disclosures caps the multiple and may cost a settlement.

valuation_philosophy.summary: House basis: owner FCF with SBC fully expensed, IFRS-16 lease cash charged in the flows (lease liabilities out of net debt), debt-like acquisition liabilities and NCI deducted in the bridge. The valuation is a trough-to-mid-cycle margin normalisation on flat-to-modest growth; recurring Business Optimization Costs are treated as a real cost of running a people-intensive services business through AI deflation, not as a one-off.
key_risks_to_valuation: GenAI reduces billable hours faster than AI Pods replace them (bear axis)
Business Optimization Costs prove permanent at >1% of revenue
Securities class action re 2023 LatAm-pivot disclosures -- no provision disclosed; settlement or credibility discount not in the bridge
Working-capital drain (DSO ~90 days and lengthening) keeps realised owner FCF below the component build, as it did FY21-25
LatAm currency appreciation against a USD revenue base compresses margins
Resumed large M&A (historically $250M+/yr) would consume FCF the base case assumes is free

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 27.56-72.10
data_sources.financials: GLOB_Metrics.csv (core_metrics); 20-F FY2025 cash-flow statement (lines 9594-9678) for SBC, lease principal/interest, capex, tax paid, repurchases; 6-K Q2-2026 for balance sheet at 30-Jun-2026, diluted shares, BOC and non-IFRS reconciliation; 6-K Q4-2025 for FY2025 adjusted op profit reconciliation
data_sources.qualitative: GLOB_Analysis.json (2026-10-04): FY2026 guidance as of the Q2-2026 call (13-Aug-2026), Glob.AI ARR, class action, customer counts

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: H1-2026 diluted weighted average 43.405M (Q2-26 6-K line 226/345); cross-checks to issued capital $52.112M / $1.20 par = 43.43M at 30-Jun-2026 and management's 43.2-43.6M guidance assumption. 1 ADS = 1 common share. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows; the $125M repurchase program funds the flat count (FY25 repurchases $56.1M cash).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 6-K Q4 non-IFRS reconciliation 'Share-based compensation expense - Equity settled' $77.7M (company's own adjusted-op-profit figure; cash-flow add-back $75.7M, 20-F FY2025 line 9601). No net-share-settlement tax withholding line on the cash-flow statement (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 every year).
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD WACC. Rf ~4.3% (10y UST), ERP 5.0%, beta ~1.25 (IT services, LatAm delivery base incl. Argentina) -> CoE ~10.6%; pre-tax cost of debt ~6% (SOFR revolver, FY25 interest paid $20.8M on ~$370-420M) -> ~4.5% after tax; market weights ~78/22 equity/(debt+debt-like) at $35 -> ~9.3%, rounded up to 10.0% for EM delivery-country exposure. Single WACC across all three scenarios: the class action, AI-disruption and credibility risks are charged ONCE, through the 30% bear weight, not through a WACC premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: lease principal ($28.6M) + lease interest ($6.8M) = $35.4M FY2025 (20-F FY2025 cash flow lines 9670-9671), 1.44% of revenue, charged via lease_cost_pct_path. Lease liabilities ($95.9M at 30-Jun-2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt. da_pct is ex right-of-use depreciation.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (NCI share of profit ~1-3%: FY25 $1.0M, H1-26 $3.6M). NCI charged once in the bridge at book ($60.4M, 30-Jun-2026). The GUT put option is part of other financial liabilities, which are also deducted; any overlap is <= ~$1.3/share and errs conservative.
inputs.notes: MODEL: Owner-FCF component DCF (routing table row 1/2: operating IT-services company; adaptations file read for leases, NCI and debt-like acquisition liabilities). First valuation of GLOB; no MEMORY.md entry. Luxembourg-incorporated, IFRS, USD reporting and USD NYSE quote, no FX. Interest income NOT stripped: Globant is net-debt (borrowings $422.0M vs cash+investments $171.4M at 30-Jun-2026); finance income ~$5.5M/yr is immaterial. BUSINESS OPTIMIZATION COSTS: $52.0M FY2025, $32.3M Q2-2026 plus a guided further $20-25M in Q3-2026 -- two consecutive annual programmes, so they are treated as a REAL cost: FY2026 EBITDA margin is set ~2.3pp below the pre-BOC run-rate, and the mature margin carries ~0.75pp/yr of recurring restructuring rather than the company's adjusted 'one-time' framing. EBITDA DEFINITION: IFRS profit from operations + D&A + SBC (pre-SBC, IFRS-16 basis, after BOC and after non-amortisation acquisition charges). FY2025: 171.7 + 187.8 + 77.7 = 437.2 = 17.8% of revenue (pre-BOC 19.9%). FY2026 anchor: guidance revenue $2,428-2,462M (mid -0.4% YoY), adjusted op margin 13.5-14.5% (vs 15.2%). WORKING CAPITAL: services receivables ~90 days DSO; growth consumes cash (FY23 -58M, FY24 -151M, FY25 -74M), so wc_capture is negative. HISTORY CHECK: owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC - lease cash) FY21-25 = 37 / 4 / 74 / 10 / 101, avg ~2.1% margin, depressed by DSO lengthening, BOC and acquisition-driven receivable build; the component build's ~6% year-1 margin is above that history and is the main judgment to audit. Not modelled: M&A (~$250-280M/yr FY23-24) -- base growth is organic only, so no acquisition spend is deducted. Class action (filed Apr-Jun 2026 re the 2023 LatAm pivot disclosures): no provision or settlement estimate in the Q2-2026 6-K; treated as a qualitative risk inside the bear weight, not a bridge liability.

bear.narrative: GenAI coding tools shrink billable hours faster than AI Pods can replace them: revenue falls ~5% in FY27 as the customer base keeps shrinking (981 -> 904 LTM) and top-10 concentration (~31%) bites; Business Optimization Costs become a permanent annual line, LatAm currency appreciation keeps squeezing the cost base, and a class-action settlement plus credibility discount keeps the market from re-rating; EBITDA stalls at ~15%.

base.narrative: FY26 lands at the guidance midpoint (-0.4%) with ~$55M of BOC; FY27 +2% as legacy T&M erosion and AI Pods growth roughly offset; mid-single-digit growth FY28-30 as AI Pods (~10pp higher gross margin) becomes a meaningful share; adjusted margin recovers to ~14.5-15% but never back to the FY22-24 peak, with ~0.75pp/yr restructuring treated as recurring.

bull.narrative: Glob.AI exits 2026 above $110M ARR and keeps compounding as the platform opens to the broader market; output-priced AI Pods replace lost hours at higher margin, top-50 account expansion (+6.9% YoY) spreads, and growth re-accelerates to high single digits by FY28 while restructuring ends and margins reach ~20.5% EBITDA (adjusted op margin ~16-17%).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: guidance cut twice in 2026, the thesis rests on an unproven pivot (AI Pods ~4% of revenue), the customer base is shrinking, and a pending securities-fraud class action questions management's prior disclosure. Base held at 50%. Bull cut to 20% because it needs AI Pods scaling, legacy-revenue stabilisation and an end to restructuring all at once.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
